note: Memory bleed Pass 3 — date-anchor removed from three system-prompt injections. Kirk 2026-08-09: tested on second machine, saw April 16 2022 + April 28 2026 + April 16 2026 — DIFFERENT dates per machine, meaning the v5.79.30/31 bleed fix worked but dates still surface. Root cause found: three injection sites rendered specific/computable dates into every system prompt. (1) memory-core.js getContext() rendered each memory's creation timestamp as `Apr 16, 2026` — an absolute date the AI reflected back. Fix: dropped absolute date, replaced with coarse recency bucket (today/this-week/this-month/recent/older). UI card at line 493 still shows date to the human — that's for browsing, expected. (2) app.html LatticeLetters.getContextBlock rendered `5 days ago` / `23 hours ago` — a specific number the AI could subtract from today. Fix: coarse bucket (this-hour/today/this-week/this-month/earlier). (3) app.html AIContinuity welcome injection said `First met N days ago` — same computable anchor. Fix: coarse tenure bucket (new to each other / weeks / a couple of months / many months / long time). All three preserve the recency SIGNAL (AI knows if a memory is fresh or old) without giving a specific number to fixate on. Audit doc updated with new row. Verified: parse clean, smoke green, no muzzling — AI still speaks freely about dates in message content or when the memory text itself contains one.
